caption: Both machines read the input 0101. Mealy prints one symbol per move and gives 0101; Moore prints on entry to each state, so its start state adds an extra leading 0 and it gives 00101.

spec.title: Run on input 0101
spec.aria: A table showing input 0101 read by a Mealy machine and a Moore machine, with each state and printed output at every step; the Moore output starts with an extra 0.
